findings.evidence: TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/Homeomorph/Congr.lean:41-53 `namespace TauCeti` / `namespace Homeomorph` / `def homeoCongr (e : M ≃ₜ N)`; TauCeti/Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Congr.lean:63-85 `namespace TauCeti` / `namespace Diffeomorph` / `def diffCongr (e : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯ N)`. `grep -n 'Topology/Algebra/Homeomorph\|Geometry/Diffeomorphism' scripts/lint-dot-notation-baseline.txt` returns only Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Sphere.lean (a LinearIsometryEquiv namespace) — none of the seven files above. Neither namespace is suppressed by `own_declaration_paths`: the only TauCeti declaration named `Homeomorph` is `_root_.Homeomorph.irreducibleComponentsEquiv` (rooted, TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/IrreducibleOfConnectedDomainStalk.lean:94), and there is no TauCeti `Diffeomorph` definition. `namespace Diffeomorph` exists in Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Diffeomorph.lean, so both names are in `mathlib_namespace_names` and neither is in ORGANISATIONAL.
findings.fix: Add `("≃ₜ", "Homeomorph")` and the Diffeomorph forms (`≃ₘ^` and `≃ₘ⟮`/`≃ₘ[`, matching Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Diffeomorph.lean:90-100) to NOTATION_RECEIVERS — note `≃ₘ^n⟮…⟯` needs a token match that tolerates the interpolated level, e.g. a regex entry alongside SPECIAL_NOTATION_RECEIVERS — cover both in scripts/test_lint_dot_notation.py, and regenerate the baseline with --write-baseline.
findings.issue: NOTATION_RECEIVERS omits `≃ₜ` (Homeomorph) and the Diffeomorph notations `≃ₘ^n⟮I, J⟯` / `≃ₘ⟮I, J⟯` / `≃ₘ^n[𝕜]` / `≃ₘ[𝕜]`. In `_top_level_notation_receiver`, `≃ₜ` fails the `≃` entry's whitespace guard (next char is `ₜ`) and then hits the `≃` in TOP_LEVEL_CONNECTIVES, returning None; `_binder_has_type`'s head regex then fails because the type is not spelled `Homeomorph`. summary: The notation table added to fix the previous round is still incomplete in a way that matters: `≃ₜ` (Homeomorph) and `≃ₘ^n⟮_,_⟯` (Diffeomorph) are absent, so seven files that recreate `Homeomorph`/`Diffeomorph` under `namespace TauCeti` with explicit receivers are invisible to the lint and absent from the regenerated baseline. The rest of the parser and the two prior findings check out.
